svg.title: MacLink setup flow
svg.desc: Mac registration, permissions, same Google account sign-in and My devices remote access.

path.aria-label: GETTING STARTED
Register your Mac. Sign in anywhere.
The Mac runs a native Connector; the remote user only needs a supported browser.
Install the Connector
Download the DMG from www.maclink.cloud.
Move MacLink into Applications and launch it.
Choose Connect with Google in the Connector.
Approve this Mac
Sign in with Google; enter the Connector code.
Approve registration; the Connector applies it.
Allow Screen/audio recording and Device control.
Sign in on another computer
Open www.maclink.cloud in a browser.
Sign in to the same Google account.
Your registered Macs appear in My devices.
Connect from My devices
Choose Connect on your online Mac.
Select view-only or control mode.
Receive the screen and system sound.
Only the same signed-in Google account can connect.
Keep the Mac awake, logged in, online and running the Connector with permissions enabled.
Optional: enable Start MacLink at login in Settings.
Sign out, disconnect or stop the Connector to end remote access.
